scopeChange: No point, clone ID, threshold or interval changes. Correct official file representation and compare numeric CRS parameters rather than display names before any clone horizon or altered-observer query.

officialEvidence.location: Site01 Clones links to the exact files used
officialEvidence.meaning: Files are presented as LDEM clones, not a separate generic noise raster.

officialEvidence.quote: Clones/ : Directory containing 100 clones of LDEM

officialEvidence.meaning: A clone is the original LDEM plus its spatially structured signed error; the error map and clone surface are distinct.

observedSupportingCheck: GeoTIFF Z ranges match original surface; clone-minus-base spans about -5 to +6 metres and RMS about 0.44m. This is corroboration, not sole semantic evidence. File suffix _err.tif does not mean the stored numbers are errors.
representation: absolute clone surface height in metres, used directly; signed diagnostic error = clone surface minus nominal surface
operation: Local occluder heights and observer ground sampled from the SAME full clone. Keep 2m equipment above that ground; request exact changed observer-height ephemerides. Do not add clone heights to base.
crs: Equivalent numeric south-polar stereographic parameters/R=1737400m/units metre and exact 5m transform/dimensions required. WKT labels unnamed vs unknown differ but not projection. MOON_ME DE421 per official product metadata.
missingData: Nonfinite or nodata anywhere nominal local surface is valid rejects that clone; missing query/source records remain unknown, never zero.
farField: Outside local tile: unchanged regional80m DEM. Regional uncertainties and tile seam effects remain unverified.
noProbability: Five fixed official clone IDs at two selected points; no frequency-to-probability or nine-point/full-horizon certification.
